name: Mango salad
summary: Gỏi xoài is the mango salad on the dinner-cruise menu in Vietnam Tourism’s four-day Mekong piece, with grilled sea bass and chicken with lemongrass.
origin: A Can Tho dinner table on the four-day piece. The operator is not a pick.
where: A table in Can Tho on that piece, not the wholesale boats.
